correctness.rationale: For finite d>=1, B=sI-C nonsingular M-matrix with C>=0 and s>rho(C), strictly positive immigration η and t>0, the quadratic inverse Laplace equation admits an analytic branch at u=0. J=(B^T)^-1 has J_(i,j)>0 iff the directed C path i->j exists; diagonal strictly positive. Repeated implicit differentiation gives labeled-set recurrence H_i(S)=1/2 sum_l J_(i,l) sum_(nontrivial ordered position splits)H_l(S1)H_l(S minus S1), H_i({a})=J_(i,j_a). All terms nonnegative; induction with l=i proves H_i(S)>0 iff i reaches all j_a. Summation against η>0 gives exact sign/zero of every cumulant. For r>=2, Levy-Khintchine mixed cumulants equal t∫product x_(j_a)ν(dx), giving simultaneous-jump support and disjoint-group independence equivalence. Exact six-type C with links 1->4,5; 2->4,6; 3->5,6, weights 1/5 gives covariances t/25 for all three pairs but third mixed cumulant of 4,5,6 exactly zero. Independently checked exact rational derivative recurrence for these examples including κ(1,4,5)=3t/25. Source 1,588 finite checks through length four do not prove arbitrary dimension/order.
